cues.text: First, it reads the year's earlier returns. One state report missed a bonus payroll.
Next, the year's payroll: 101 people paid in 2026. The last quarter isn't finished yet, so it uses a projection from the pay schedule.
Now it checks the IRS rules online. All eighteen checks are confirmed; four questions are left for a person.

Then it works out the tax. FUTA is charged only on each employee's first $7,000 of pay. Paying state unemployment tax earns the FUTA credit, which cuts the rate from 6 percent to 0.6 percent. The tax is $4,242.
Eleven checks pass, all to the cent.
Last, it writes the draft return and its workpapers.

All done. The draft shows $4,242 of tax for the year. Most of it is already deposited, leaving about $186 to pay. Six items stay open, including a deposit made one day late, a worker paid as a vendor, and a fourth quarter that is still projected. A person reviews, signs and files; nothing is filed or paid.

parked.text: Watch F1 Finance's tax machine prepare HANGS General Contracting's 2026 Form 940: the yearly federal unemployment tax return, called FUTA.
